title: Post-correction authoritative bookkeeping verification
decision: Implement discovery Option B: after canonical completed FOOD-006U, perform a fresh canonical FOOD-006P authoritative recorded-balance validation and then canonical FOOD-006R mechanical reconciliation against the exact historical FOOD-006Q count observation retained through correction provenance.
eligibility: Canonical FOOD-006U no-correction-required returns without database access.
FOOD-006U blocked is ineligible for whole-correction verification.
Malformed or tampered completed/no-correction input returns invalid before database access.
completedFlow: Revalidate the canonical FOOD-006T candidate bundle and every completed FOOD-006U attempt before database access.
Require every completed attempt result to be created or already-present and to contain the exact canonical candidate movement.
Call validateFoodAuthoritativeRecordedInventoryBalanceAtReadPoint exactly once using the candidate bundle exact SKU.
If FOOD-006P validates, call reconcileFoodExactSkuPhysicalInventory with the fresh FOOD-006P result and the original canonical FOOD-006Q count observation.
Preserve the original reconciliation, fresh validated recorded balance and fresh mechanical bookkeeping reconciliation.

freshReadOutcomes.validated: Return verified with canonical FOOD-006R bookkeeping reconciliation.
freshReadOutcomes.stale: Return stale and the later exact-SKU evidence head; do not report verified.
freshReadOutcomes.invalid: Fail closed to storage-failure because the request SKU was derived from canonical correction provenance.

retrySemantics: A completed FOOD-006U result containing already-present movements remains eligible. FOOD-006V does not require an evidence-head increase merely because the orchestration was retried.
movementInclusion: Not proven. FOOD-006V does not claim that any observed head transition was caused by the correction movements and does not claim every correction movement was included in the fresh cutoff.
historicalCountSemantics: The reused FOOD-006Q observation remains the historical caller-asserted physical count. Reconciliation against a fresh recorded balance is mechanical bookkeeping comparison only; it is not a new physical count.
verifiedSafeClaim: A fresh authoritative exact-SKU recorded balance was reconstructed and validated by FOOD-006P after a completed FOOD-006U result, then mechanically compared by FOOD-006R with the exact historical physical-count observation retained in correction provenance.
doesNotEstablish: correction movement inclusion in the fresh evidence cutoff
truth or completeness of the historical physical count
absence of later exact-SKU inventory events
